scope.operation: Normalize a caller-provided surface normal and apply the decoded DRW_AcisFace::senseReversed flag.
scope.inputContract: The caller supplies a finite, nonzero normal for the corresponding surface at the desired point; face.hasSense must be true.
scope.outputContract: On success, return a unit vector in the retained face-sense direction. On failure, leave the output unchanged.
scope.semanticLimit: This composes an already-decoded boolean with an external normal; it does not derive a surface normal or establish producer/version semantics.
